# Qefro

> Qefro is the AI Business Application Platform.

Connect your systems. Build intelligent applications. Automate your organization.

## Core pillars

- **Connect** — External SDK Connections and APIs to ERP, CRM, inventory, and internal systems
- **Build** — Managed Marketplace Apps and custom applications on the Qefro SDK
- **Automate** — Organization Workflows, approvals, tasks, and teams

## Product surfaces

- External SDK Connections (`/qefro` protocol)
- Managed Marketplace Apps (Restaurant Pro, Clinic Pro, custom)
- Customer Hub (identity layer across applications)
- Organization Workflows (events, actions, approvals, tasks)
- Channels: Website, WhatsApp, Internal Portal, API
- Workspaces, RBAC, Marketing, Storage
